parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in assays against human amine oxidase B (flavin-containing). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for the target name. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return only the columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
